author: Athune
body: I'm somewhat of a new player to this community and really look forward to talking to most of y'all on the server! If you have any concerns or questions I could possibly help you. I'm nice towards the players and crack jokes now and then. I help people a lot and that's it pretty much, I look forward to seeing you all in game!
